## Modules

- [PhiaUi](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.md): PhiaUI — a shadcn/ui-inspired component library for Phoenix LiveView.
- [PhiaUi.Application](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Application.md): OTP Application entry-point for PhiaUi.
- [PhiaUi.ClassMerger](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.ClassMerger.md): Native Tailwind CSS class merger for PhiaUi.
- [PhiaUi.ClassMerger.Cache](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.ClassMerger.Cache.md): ETS-backed cache for memoising resolved Tailwind class strings.
- [PhiaUi.ClassMerger.Groups](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.ClassMerger.Groups.md): Maps Tailwind CSS utility class tokens to their conflict group.
- [PhiaUi.Collab.CollabPresence](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Collab.CollabPresence.md): Phoenix.Presence wrapper for collaborative editing sessions.
- [PhiaUi.Collab.CollabRoom](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Collab.CollabRoom.md): GenServer managing a single collaboration room session.
- [PhiaUi.Collab.RoomManager](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Collab.RoomManager.md): Manages collaboration room lifecycles via `DynamicSupervisor`.
- [PhiaUi.Collab.Supervisor](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Collab.Supervisor.md): Top-level supervisor for PhiaUI collaboration infrastructure.
- [PhiaUi.ComponentRegistry](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.ComponentRegistry.md): Source of truth for all 829 PhiaUI components.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Accordion](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Accordion.md): Accordion component using exclusively `Phoenix.LiveView.JS` — no JS hooks required.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ActionButton](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ActionButton.md): Specialized action buttons for common UI interaction patterns.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ActionSheet](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ActionSheet.md): Mobile-style action sheet component — a sliding bottom panel.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ActivityFeed](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ActivityFeed.md): Activity feed / audit log component for PhiaUI.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AdvancedSelects](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AdvancedSelects.md): Advanced select components for PhiaUI.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Alert](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Alert.md): Inline feedback alert for communicating status, errors, and warnings.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AlertDialog](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AlertDialog.md): Alert Dialog component for critical confirmations requiring explicit user action.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AnimatedSurface](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AnimatedSurface.md): Animated surface components for PhiaUI — 5 components covering rotating
border beams, shine effects, cursor-tracked gradients, spotlights, and
moving gradient borders.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Animation](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Animation.md): Animation primitives for PhiaUI — 22 components covering infinite loops,
background effects, text effects, entry/scroll animations, interactive hover,
counter animations, decorative borders, CSS loaders, and canvas effects.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AppShell](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AppShell.md): Application shell layout component providing a full-page grid structure.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AppStoreButton](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AppStoreButton.md): Apple App Store and Google Play Store badge buttons.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ArcDiagram](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ArcDiagram.md): Arc diagram — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AreaChart](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AreaChart.md): Filled area chart — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Article](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Article.md): Semantic article component with structured title, meta, lead, body, and footer.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ArticleCard](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ArticleCard.md): ArticleCard — a blog post / article preview card.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AspectRatio](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AspectRatio.md): Utility component that maintains a fixed aspect ratio for any child content.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AudioPlayer](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AudioPlayer.md): AudioPlayer component for playing audio with play/pause, progress bar and timestamp.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AutocompleteInput](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AutocompleteInput.md): Text input with HTML5 datalist suggestions.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Avatar](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Avatar.md): Circular user avatar with automatic image-fallback to initials.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AvatarGroup](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AvatarGroup.md): AvatarGroup — an overlapping stack of avatars with built-in overflow badge.
- [PhiaUi.Components.AvatarUpload](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.AvatarUpload.md): Circular or square profile photo uploader with overlay edit icon.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BackToTop](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BackToTop.md): Floating "back to top" button that appears after scrolling past a threshold.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BackTop](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BackTop.md): BackTop component — a floating "scroll to top" button.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Background](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Background.md): Background pattern and decoration components for PhiaUI.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Badge](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Badge.md): Compact inline label for status indicators, tags, version numbers, and counts.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BadgeCalendar](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BadgeCalendar.md): Month calendar where each day cell can show a small badge count at the top
and the day number at the bottom.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BadgeDelta](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BadgeDelta.md): Delta badge — a colored pill showing a metric trend with an icon.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BadgeGroup](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BadgeGroup.md): Badge + text description combo component.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Banner](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Banner.md): Full-width page-level feedback banners inspired by Atlassian Design System Banner,
Bootstrap Alerts, and GitHub's site-wide announcement banners.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BarChart](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BarChart.md): Vertical grouped / stacked / horizontal bar chart — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BarList](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BarList.md): Horizontal bar list — ranks items by value with proportional bars.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Bento](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Bento.md): Bento grid components for PhiaUI — 4 components for Apple-style modular
grid layouts with varying cell spans.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BigCalendar](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BigCalendar.md): Full-page monthly calendar with colored event pills and a view switcher.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BookingCalendar](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BookingCalendar.md): Airbnb-style booking calendar with per-cell availability states.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BottomNavigation](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BottomNavigation.md): BottomNavigation component — a fixed bottom tab bar for mobile/PWA apps.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BoxPlot](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BoxPlot.md): Box-and-whisker plot — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Breadcrumb](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Breadcrumb.md): Breadcrumb navigation component following the shadcn/ui Breadcrumb anatomy.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BubbleChart](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BubbleChart.md): XY bubble chart with variable-radius circles — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BulkActionBar](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BulkActionBar.md): BulkActionBar component for PhiaUI.
- [PhiaUi.Components.BulletChart](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.BulletChart.md): Bullet chart — progress toward target with colored range bands — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Button](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Button.md): Stateless Button component with 6 variants and 7 sizes.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ButtonGroup](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ButtonGroup.md): Groups multiple buttons into a unified bar with shared borders.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Calendar](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Calendar.md): Server-rendered calendar component for date selection with keyboard navigation.
- [PhiaUi.Components.CalendarTimePicker](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.CalendarTimePicker.md): Calendar + scrollable time slot picker for date-and-time selection.
- [PhiaUi.Components.CalendarWeekView](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.CalendarWeekView.md): Week-view calendar with time axis and absolute-positioned event blocks.
- [PhiaUi.Components.CandlestickChart](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.CandlestickChart.md): Candlestick chart for financial OHLC data — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Card](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Card.md): Composable Card component with 6 independent sub-components.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Carousel](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Carousel.md): Carousel component with touch swipe, button navigation, and keyboard support.
- [PhiaUi.Components.CategoryBar](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.CategoryBar.md): Stacked category bar — normalizes values to 100% and renders colored segments.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Chart](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Chart.md): Chart integration component powered by the `PhiaChart` vanilla JS hook.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ChartShell](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ChartShell.md): Titled card container for charts and data visualisations.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ChatMessage](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ChatMessage.md): Chat interface components for PhiaUI.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Checkbox](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Checkbox.md): Native HTML checkbox component styled with Tailwind CSS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Chip](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Chip.md): Interactive Chip component for tags, filters, and multi-select interfaces.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ChipNav](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ChipNav.md): Chip-style filter/tag navigation component.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ChordChart](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ChordChart.md): Chord diagram — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.CirclePackingChart](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.CirclePackingChart.md): Circle packing chart — pure SVG, zero JS.
- [PhiaUi.Components.CircularProgress](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.CircularProgress.md): Radial/circular progress indicator rendered as an SVG arc.
- [PhiaUi.Components.ClearableInput](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.ClearableInput.md): Text input with an inline × clear button.
- [PhiaUi.Components.CodeSnippet](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.CodeSnippet.md): Code display card with filename header, language badge, copy button, and line numbers.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Collab.CollabComment](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Collab.CollabComment.md): Collaboration Comment Suite — 6 components for rendering and interacting

- [PhiaUi.Components.Collab.Composer](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Collab.Composer.md): Composer Suite — 3 components for comment input with @mention support.
- [PhiaUi.Components.Collab.Cursor](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/PhiaUi.Components.Collab.Cursor.md): Collaborative cursor and selection components for real-time multiplayer UIs.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix phia.add](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Add.md): Ejects a PhiaUI component into the current Phoenix project as an editable
source file.
- [mix phia.design](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Design.md): Starts the PhiaUI Design tool — a visual component editor.
- [mix phia.design.analyze](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Design.Analyze.md): Analyze a saved PhiaUI design file.
- [mix phia.design.export](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Design.Export.md): Export a saved PhiaUI design to HEEx or LiveView source files.
- [mix phia.design.mcp](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Design.Mcp.md): Starts the PhiaUI Design MCP server for Claude Code integration.
- [mix phia.icons](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Icons.md): Generates the Lucide SVG sprite used by `PhiaUi.Components.Icon`.
- [mix phia.install](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Install.md): Sets up PhiaUI in the current Phoenix project.
- [mix phia.theme](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Theme.md): Manage PhiaUI color theme presets from the command line.
- [mix phia.undaisy](https://phia-ui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phia.Undaisy.md): Removes all DaisyUI references from a Phoenix LiveView project.
